questions.explanation: 由上文可知作者对伦敦奥运会充满热情，想参与其中。因此他“不介意(didn't care)”即使自己只是在场馆外跳舞。A符合句意，表示“在乎，介意”。
questions.supplement:
A(care)：语境句：I really don't care what they think of me. 固定搭配：care about, care for
B(admit)：语境句：He admitted having stolen the money. 固定搭配：admit doing sth, admit to
C(doubt)：语境句：I doubt if he will keep his promise. 固定搭配：beyond doubt, without a doubt
D(know)：语境句：She knows exactly how to handle the situation. 固定搭配：know about, let sb know

questions.explanation: 后文提到在“水上运动中心(Aquatics Centre)”、涉及“5米深的池子(5-metre-deep pool)”以及将人从水里救出，由此推断作者申请的职位是“救生员(lifeguards)”。
questions.supplement:
A(coaches)：语境句：The team hired two new coaches this season. 固定搭配：head coach, sports coach
B(athletes)：语境句：Many athletes train for years to compete in the Olympics. 固定搭配：professional athlete, track athlete
C(lifeguards)：语境句：The lifeguard saved the drowning boy. 固定搭配：on duty lifeguard, beach lifeguard
D(firefighters)：语境句：Firefighters risked their lives to put out the blaze. 固定搭配：brave firefighter, firefighter gear

questions.explanation: 作者认为会有成千上万的人申请这个职位，因此他从未期望能够“收到回复(hear back)”。B选项符合此处逻辑。
questions.supplement:
A(step away)：语境句：He decided to step away from the company for a while. 固定搭配：step away from, step away for a moment
B(hear back)：语境句：I applied for the job but haven't heard back yet. 固定搭配：hear back from sb, wait to hear back
C(show off)：语境句：He bought a sports car just to show off. 固定搭配：show off one's skills, show off to sb
D(sign up)：语境句：You can sign up for the course online. 固定搭配：sign up for, sign up online

questions.explanation: 后文提到了“淘汰赛阶段(knockout stages)”以及只有一次机会等测试环节，说明这是一个为期两天的“选拔/试训(trial)”。
questions.supplement:
A(routine)：语境句：Exercise has become part of my daily routine. 固定搭配：daily routine, break the routine
B(practice)：语境句：It takes a lot of practice to play the piano well. 固定搭配：in practice, out of practice
C(experiment)：语境句：They are conducting an experiment to test the theory. 固定搭配：do an experiment, conduct an experiment
D(trial)：语境句：He was hired on a six-month trial basis. 固定搭配：clinical trial, stand trial

questions.explanation: 破折号后面解释了具体情况：有淘汰阶段且只有一次机会，说明竞争十分激烈、气氛“紧张(intense)”。
questions.supplement:
A(dangerous)：语境句：It is dangerous to walk alone at night. 固定搭配：highly dangerous, potentially dangerous
B(simple)：语境句：The solution to this problem is quite simple. 固定搭配：simple life, plain and simple
C(intense)：语境句：The candidate faced intense competition for the job. 固定搭配：intense heat, intense pressure
D(valuable)：语境句：She offered some valuable advice on my career. 固定搭配：valuable experience, highly valuable

questions.explanation: 在第一轮中，那些“未能(failing)”潜入5米深池底的人被淘汰(were cut)了。failing to do sth表示未能做某事。
questions.supplement:
A(pretending)：语境句：He was pretending to be asleep when I walked in. 固定搭配：pretend to do, pretend that
B(intending)：语境句：She is intending to study abroad next year. 固定搭配：intend to do, intend for
C(failing)：语境句：Failing to prepare is preparing to fail. 固定搭配：fail to do, without fail
D(desiring)：语境句：Desiring a better life, he worked day and night. 固定搭配：desire to do, a strong desire

questions.explanation: 作者最初觉得自己没戏(never expected to hear back)，并且测试过程非常艰难。所以当最终通过时，他感到“难以置信(disbelief)”。
questions.supplement:
A(misfortune)：语境句：He had the misfortune to lose his job. 固定搭配：suffer misfortune, a great misfortune
B(disbelief)：语境句：She shook her head in sheer disbelief. 固定搭配：in disbelief, stare in disbelief
C(dishonesty)：语境句：He was fired for dishonesty and theft. 固定搭配：academic dishonesty, act of dishonesty
D(misunderstanding)：语境句：A simple misunderstanding caused the whole conflict. 固定搭配：clear up a misunderstanding, avoid misunderstanding

questions.explanation: 由but引出的后半句“运动员很重视我们”可知，前半句是在说网上有些人不以为然，将他们的工作“贬低(dismissed)”为世界上最简单的工作。dismiss sb as... 意为“把某人打发走/对某人嗤之以鼻并认定为”。
questions.supplement:
A(trusted)：语境句：I have always trusted her completely. 固定搭配：trust sb with sth, trust in
B(admired)：语境句：I really admired him for his courage. 固定搭配：admire sb for sth, deeply admire
C(discovered)：语境句：Scientists have discovered a new species of bird. 固定搭配：discover the truth, make a discovery
D(dismissed)：语境句：He dismissed her idea as totally unrealistic. 固定搭配：dismiss sth as, dismiss an employee

questions.explanation: 后一句提到“我曾得到过一顶英国队的游泳帽”，说明运动员不仅重视他们，有时甚至会“赠送礼物(gifted)”给他们。
questions.supplement:
A(gifted)：语境句：The wealthy businessman gifted a large sum of money to the charity. 固定搭配：gift sb sth, highly gifted (adj.)
B(assisted)：语境句：The doctor was assisted by two nurses during the operation. 固定搭配：assist sb with sth, assist in doing
C(bothered)：语境句：He wasn't bothered by the negative comments. 固定搭配：bother to do, can't be bothered
D(ignored)：语境句：She ignored his warnings and went out into the storm. 固定搭配：completely ignore, ignore the fact

questions.explanation: 句意：即使你是顶尖的外科医生，但如果不知道如何“正确地(correctly)”把人从水里拉出来，甚至在他们得到治疗前就已经造成伤害了。强调救生员救助手法的专业性和正确性。
questions.supplement:
A(correctly)：语境句：Make sure you spell your name correctly on the form. 固定搭配：answer correctly, guess correctly
B(immediately)：语境句：She answered the email almost immediately. 固定搭配：immediately after, respond immediately
C(gently)：语境句：He gently placed the baby in the crib. 固定搭配：speak gently, smile gently
D(hurriedly)：语境句：He hurriedly packed his bags and left. 固定搭配：leave hurriedly, hurriedly written

questions.explanation: 下文举例说“我记得曾救过一名头部朝前撞到池壁的运动员”，这是典型的“意外事故(accidents)”。因此选B。
questions.supplement:

B(accidents)：语境句：Traffic accidents frequently occur on this wet road. 固定搭配：by accident, traffic accident
C(changes)：语境句：We need to make some changes to the plan. 固定搭配：make changes, climate change
D(events)：语境句：The historical events shaped the country's future. 固定搭配：current events, sporting event

questions.explanation: 前文提到会遇到明星感到追星般的震撼(starstruck moments)，但紧接着That said(话虽如此)发生转折，说明当你坐在裁判/救生椅上时，你变得非常“专业(professional)”，会忘掉明星光环，专注于工作。
questions.supplement:
A(annoying)：语境句：It's really annoying when people interrupt me. 固定搭配：highly annoying, find sth annoying
B(painful)：语境句：Losing a loved one is a very painful experience. 固定搭配：painful memory, acutely painful
C(impressive)：语境句：Her presentation was highly impressive. 固定搭配：impressive performance, look impressive
D(professional)：语境句：She handled the difficult situation in a professional manner. 固定搭配：highly professional, professional career

questions.explanation: 根据后半句“检查每个运动员的动作，看是否有什么不对劲”，这说明救生员在脑子里进行的是“风险评估(risk assessments)”。

B(risk assessments)：语境句：The manager asked us to conduct comprehensive risk assessments. 固定搭配：carry out risk assessments, environmental risk assessment

D(work arrangements)：语境句：We need to discuss our flexible work arrangements. 固定搭配：flexible work arrangements, alternative work arrangements

questions.explanation: 前句说到“并非所有事都会在电视上播出”，说明看守泳池的工作是在“幕后(behind the scene / behind the scenes)”默默进行的。

D(in the spotlight)：语境句：The politician has been in the spotlight since the scandal broke. 固定搭配：step into the spotlight, steal the spotlight

questions.explanation: 结合上一句“不在电视上播出”及“幕后工作”，可知救生员的角色是不引人注目的、“未被看见的(unseen)”，但他们依然至关重要(matters)。

A(unexpected)：语境句：His sudden resignation was completely unexpected. 固定搭配：unexpected outcome, unexpected guest

D(unseen)：语境句：Many unseen forces are shaping the economy. 固定搭配：unseen dangers, remain unseen

Renli Village in Ziyang City, Sichuan Province, Southwest China, is home to a digital nomad community founded by Ke Yu, a girl born in 2000. [56] village, just a half-hour drive from downtown, helps escape the pollution, traffic and city crowds. With a gentle mountain wind, the smell of freshly cooked coffee and newly baked bread, it is not hard to figure out [57] so many digital nomads have chosen to live and work here.
"Digital nomads" are generally individuals who, thanks to advances in communication infrastructure (基础设施), make income through the Internet independent of traditional office [58]. Ke is familiar with the trend.
In late 2023, while searching for a remote working location, Ke [59] a photo online of Renli Village with three unused buildings, which, with minimal adaptation, could [60] for offices, accommodations and even entertainment spaces for the community.
Many digital nomads are united by a shared desire, [61] is to escape the fast-paced and high-pressure life of big cities to work in scenic and cost-effective locations. But, besides this, what unique experiences can be offered? Ke had an idea.
Ke and her partners invited artists from around the world [62] 10 interconnected art pieces, providing visitors with a [63] distinctive artistic journey. Within the 2,000-square-meter shared office space in the community, facilities [64] three-dimensional printers, live-streaming rooms and studio lights are provided to meet the specific needs of the remote workers typically [65] careers such as creative design, programming and media.

questions.explanation: 前文已经提到了Renli Village，此处再次提到“这个村子”表特指，故填定冠词The。位于句首需大写。
questions.supplement: 正确形(The)：语境句：The book on the table belongs to my teacher. 固定搭配：in the morning, the same as。原词无特殊变形及搭配。

questions.explanation: 句意为：不难理解“为什么”有这么多数字游民选择在这里生活和工作。此处引导宾语从句且表示原因，故填why。
questions.supplement: 正确形(why)：语境句：I really don't understand why he left so early. 固定搭配：that is why, the reason why。原词无特殊变形及搭配。

questions.explanation: 此处意为“传统的办公环境”。setting作为“环境、背景”为可数名词，这里泛指各种传统办公室环境，用复数settings更符合语境。
questions.supplement: 正确形(settings)：语境句：The application allows you to customize your privacy settings. 固定搭配：in a rural setting, default settings。原词setting其它变形：set(v.) set up, set off。

questions.explanation: 句子时间状语为“In late 2023”，指过去发生的动作，故谓语动词用一般过去时encountered，意为“偶然遇到/看到”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(encountered)：语境句：We encountered numerous challenges during the expedition. 固定搭配：encounter difficulties, encounter resistance。原词encounter无特殊变形。

questions.explanation: 主语which代指三栋废弃建筑，与repurpose(重新改变用途)是被动关系。情态动词could后接被动语态的动词原形，故填be repurposed。
questions.supplement: 正确形(be repurposed)：语境句：These empty factories can be repurposed as modern art galleries. 固定搭配：repurpose sth for sth, be repurposed as。原词repurpose其它变形：purpose(n.) on purpose, for the purpose of。

questions.explanation: 逗号后为非限制性定语从句，先行词是“a shared desire”，在从句中作主语，故用关系代词which。
questions.supplement: 正确形(which)：语境句：He offered to help me, which was very kind of him. 固定搭配：in which, from which。原词无特殊变形。

questions.explanation: 考查固定搭配 invite sb to do sth (邀请某人做某事)，此处用不定式作宾语补足语，填to design。
questions.supplement: 正确形(to design)：语境句：They hired an architect to design their new house. 固定搭配：design sth for sb, be designed to do。原词design其它变形：designer(n.) fashion designer, designed(adj.)。

questions.explanation: 此处修饰形容词 distinctive (独特的)，需要用副词形式 truly，意为“真正地”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(truly)：语境句：It is truly an honor to be invited here today. 固定搭配：truly believe, yours truly。原词true其它变形：truth(n.) tell the truth, truthful(adj.)。

questions.explanation: 此处表示举例，“包括3D打印机等设施”，作介词使用，填 including (或者 like)。高考一空一词中 including 最为常见。
questions.supplement: 正确形(including)：语境句：The tour costs $100, including meals and tickets. 固定搭配：up to and including, not including。原词include其它变形：inclusive(adj.) all-inclusive, inclusion(n.)。

questions.explanation: 修饰前面的名词 remote workers，由于workers和pursue(追求、从事)是主动关系，故用现在分词 pursuing 作后置定语。
questions.supplement: 正确形(pursuing)：语境句：She is currently pursuing a master's degree in computer science. 固定搭配：pursue a career, pursue a goal。原词pursue其它变形：pursuit(n.) in pursuit of, pursuer(n.)。
